text:
maria: Heads-up: assessor wants a coordinated retest snapshot + clock-sync check before next week. We need to confirm windows, what logs/snapshots to produce, and the ephemeral role TTL.

jake: what windows are we thinking? can do nightly 02:00-04:00 PT or next Tue 09:00-11:00 PT. prefer lower-traffic slot.

lisa: 02:00 PT is better for retention exports. also need to know which audit streams they require (kinesis/auditd/nginx). sampler rates matter.

sam: KMS note — assessors need decrypt-once access via ephemeral role; TTL currently set to 1h for assessor role. do we bump to 3h for the retest? implications for key access logs.

maria: propose: nightly 02:00-03:30 PT snapshot + 3h ephemeral. That gives room for snapshot, quick reruns, and evidence packaging. Anyone object?

jake: fine from scheduling side. will label maintenance window in calendar and notify SRE.

lisa: checklist of artifacts we'll hand over:
- S3 snapshot path: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/buckets/redwood-pt-evidence/retreat-1781234567/
- auditd logs (host), nginx access logs (last 48h), application request traces (x-trace IDs), and KMS key usage export.
- sampling: keep 100% request logging for the 30min before snapshot + 30min after. other times can be 1% sample.

sam: for the ephemeral role, we need an explicit IAM policy snippet. Suggest TTL=3h, require mfa, and record session name as assessor-<assessor-id>. Example policy snippet:```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect": "Allow", "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"], "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01"}
  ]
}
```

infra-bot: snapshot job queued: `snapshot-create --env=prod --tag=pt-1781234567 --window=02:00-02:30-PT` (job id: snap-1781234). will post completion when done.

maria: thanks infra-bot. lisa, can you confirm retention export TTL and encryption metadata (we need CMK id and wrapping algorithm in evidence bundle)?

lisa: CMK is `arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01`. wrapping alg = AES-GCM. retention export will include a signed manifest. I'll attach after snapshot.

jake: on the retest coordination: we should set a small rollback corridor in case the retest triggers runbooks. propose 30m buffer after snapshot reserved for runbook/manual rollback.

maria: agreed. action items:
- jake: create calendar maintenance + notify oncall by EOD.
- lisa: prepare evidence bundle + signed manifest, confirm sample rates.
- sam: create ephemeral role with TTL=3h and send assessor onboarding steps.
- infra-bot: run snapshot job and post results.

sam: I'll draft the assessor onboarding doc and post in this thread once done.

jake: noted. tagging @oncall for awareness :rotating_light:

maria: perfect. We'll re-check tomorrow 10:00 PT quick sync. :thumbsup:
